edits.new: Derive `title` solely from finalized `meaning`. Give its central topic a brief, natural name. When several actions serve a stated goal, name the goal and leave the actions in `meaning`. The title may use a broader familiar name for the same topic; `meaning` supplies the exact scope and qualifications. Do not change `meaning` to fit the title. If `meaning` is null, `title` must be null.
edits.old: Derive `title` solely from the finalized `meaning`. Give the central thing, idea or goal a brief, natural name. Use a familiar overall name for a detailed topic; the title may be broader than the precise definition. `meaning` supplies the exact scope, steps and qualifications. Do not change `meaning` to fit the title. If `meaning` is null, `title` must be null.
